facts.fact: Micah 记录 Maple 第十天体重与食欲。
Maple 试图飞起失败，但继续玩耍。
facts.anchor: Repeated failed attempts at flight observed.

facts.fact: Micah 回想兽医学校所学的 Alder Ridge 狮鹫污染案例。
facts.anchor: Nearly every chick hatched over a three-year span had malformed wings.

facts.fact: Micah 尚不能确定 Maple 的翼病成因。
facts.anchor: But Maple doesn’t fit that pattern. She seems to be the only dragon with the condition.
When he lifts out the prototype, my breath catches.

facts.fact: Maple 首次借义翅短暂离地。
facts.anchor: For one glorious heartbeat, all four of her feet leave the ground.

facts.fact: Maple 不适应义翅并挣脱。
facts.anchor: She throws herself onto the grass, rolling from side to side in an obvious attempt to take the wings off.

facts.fact: Maple 喷火烧坏样件皮膜。
facts.anchor: A stream of bright orange fire engulfs the leather.

facts.fact: Lucan 承认概念可行，准备改进。
facts.anchor: “Now I just need to make it better.”
